Senior Software Engineer, Backend – Web Products

Summary:
Backend engineer shaping scalable AI-powered healthcare payment and audit products at Machinify. Setting technical direction, building distributed systems, and advancing agentic engineering practices.
Backend engineer shaping AI-powered healthcare payment and audit products at Machinify
Role description:
• Set technical direction for backend development and design and build scalable, reliable web application systems
• Direct and review AI coding agents’ output while maintaining engineering quality
• Drive adoption of new languages, tools, and agentic development practices across the team
• Write code impacting customers and future product lines
• Partner cross-functionally to influence product direction and work directly with customers
• Understand the healthcare claims and payments domain
• Build production-grade Java, Scala, and/or Rust services; contribute standards and mentor others
• Serve as the backend voice in cross-team planning and support cross-functional execution
• Contribute to complex in-browser application development, ensuring extensibility, scalability, and security
• Balance customer-facing features with technical debt cleanup
• Architect and implement applications applying ML techniques to large volumes of data
• Design systems for performant and reliable application delivery
• Bring agentic engineering practices into day-to-day team work and help adoption
Role requirements:
• 10+ years of experience across backend programming; additional full-stack experience highly desired
• Proven experience designing and shipping customer-facing web application products
• Meaningful experience with Java or Scala; Rust highly desired
• Experience designing, building, and operating distributed systems on cloud services at scale, with high throughput and high availability
• Ability to write Technical Design Documents that translate ambiguous product intent into concrete backend design
• Product- and user-driven mindset
• Strong cross-functional collaboration with engineering peers, senior PM, ML/DS partners, and leadership
• Pragmatic approach with strong systems instinct and root-cause analysis
• Hands-on experience with agentic engineering tools and workflows in production
• Experience reading and understanding complex code, owning code quality, and improving it
• Critical thinking and problem-solving skills in a high-growth, high-stakes environment
• Comfort with complexity and curiosity to define the path forward
• BS or MS in Computer Science (or equivalent experience)

Tech stack:
Cloud, Distributed Systems, Java, Rust, Scala
